direction: D15 fresh validation of the frozen typed action contract
evidenceRole: A single-policy replication on the previously unread D14 validation split. It may authorize one untouched test read, but it is not a claim about private programming-agent traffic.

dataBoundary.readAuthorization: The protocol, direct runner, direct validator, answer runner, answer validator, and a checksummed admission artifact must be committed before validation data are loaded.

invariants.singlePolicy: Only typed-action-contract-v1 is executable; no renderer ladder or threshold search is allowed.
invariants.structuralTrigger: Exactly the D14 premise-evidence-ktalico-mi8-co2-ds1-cc1200 trigger, scope adapter, latest-version rule, and source certificate.
invariants.base: Every validation Base context is regenerated through MemoryCore SQLite L0 FTS5 and remains a byte-identical prefix of the candidate.
invariants.readerPrompt: Exactly the D14 LongMemEval-V2 domain prompt and question construction.
invariants.modelsAndJudges: Exactly MiniMax-M3 and deepseek-v4-flash in the frozen crossed two-reader/two-judge panel.
invariants.noPostValidationTuning: Any decision-changing change after validation is read rejects this protocol and requires a new split; test cannot become design data.

candidate.requiredGenerationContract: Use the corrected conclusion as the final boxed answer; a sufficient refutation must not be reduced to UNKNOWN.
candidate.hardFallback: Disabled, D14 selection failure, missing or corrupt source, renderer failure, timeout, item or token overflow, or certificate failure returns exact Base.

answerPanel.scope: Generate fresh Base and typed-action-contract answers only for validation questions whose context changed. Every unchanged validation question contributes exact paired delta zero without a model call.

promotion.validationPass: A direct and answer pass replicates D15 on fresh public data and authorizes one frozen test read.
promotion.validationFailure: Any direct or answer gate failure rejects D15 under this protocol; do not retune on validation and keep test unread.
promotion.testPass: Test confirmation remains a public long-dialogue method result, not proof on internal multi-turn programming sessions.

claimBoundary: Development selected the renderer; validation estimates replication and cannot be pooled with development as if both were untouched.
The direct structural label is a deterministic source certificate; answer correctness still depends on two model families and a strict judge rubric.
LongMemEval-V2 ordered UI inventories are a method proxy for source-certified programming constraints, not a programming benchmark.
Validation with fewer than two valid triggers is a predeclared replication failure, not permission to weaken the gate.
